facts.business: Triveni Glass Limited is a non-operational company with no revenue from operations, generating income primarily from sale of fixed assets and interest income.

auditor.name: M/s. Amit Ray & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: company has no revenue from operations and is non-operational; Other matter: NCLT petition under Section 7 of IBC by Laxmi Float Glass Limited pending adjudication, company acknowledges debt of Rs 11.14 crore and disputes additional interest claim of Rs 4.63 crore; arbitration proceedings also pending.

key_risks: Company is non-operational with no revenue from operations
NCLT petition under Section 7 of IBC by Laxmi Float Glass Limited pending adjudication
Disputed debt of Rs 11.14 crore and additional interest claim of Rs 4.63 crore
Pending arbitration proceedings with financial creditor
GST penalty case of Rs 9.87 crore
Various litigation matters including EPF, excise, and gas charging disputes
